description: The dividend per share one company listed in Paris pays for the current fiscal year: amount, status (confirmed by two registers, announced by one, revised, disputed), nature (interim, final, total, special), ex-date, payment date, the filings that state it with the sentence quoted, and the amounts of earlier fiscal years. Pass an ISIN or a company name; an ambiguous name is refused with the candidates.

company.description: An ISIN (12 characters) or a company name, in French or as listed.

name: get_french_dividend

amount_eur.description: Per share. null when disputed or unpublished.

quote.description: The sentence of the filing that states the figure, in French.

status.description: null when no dividend is published for the current fiscal year.

title: Dividend of a French listed company
